name: Honda Civic Type R (EK9)
h1: Honda Civic Type R EK9 (1997–2000): specs, B16B VTEC engine and what owners say

us.x: Never sold new in the US; the EK9 was sold only in Japan. A car becomes legal to import under the 25-year rule once it is 25 years old from its date of manufacture, so the first EK9s (on sale from August 1997) began to qualify in 2022.

fame.x: Launched in Japan in August 1997, the EK9 was the first Civic to wear the Type R badge. Every Civic Type R since traces back to it.
In Initial D, Daiki Ninomiya of the Todo School drives an EK9 Civic Type R. The school’s Spoon Sports EK9 is the pride of its Honda fleet.
The 1.6-liter B16B makes 185 PS, about 114 bhp per liter by evo’s count. Wikipedia calls it one of the highest outputs per liter of all time for an engine without a turbo or supercharger.

fame.t: A race car for the road
fame.x: Honda gave it a hand-ported engine, a seam-welded body for stiffness, a helical limited-slip differential, red Recaro seats and a titanium gear knob. Its signature color is Championship White.
Hagerty UK says the EK9 name stands tall with Gran Turismo fans.

gens.tag: 1.6-liter B16B DOHC VTEC, 185 PS (182 hp) at 8,200 rpm and an 8,400 rpm redline, 5-speed manual, front-drive. Japan only.

variants.name: Civic Type R

top.note: 225 km/h per Wikipedia; evo estimates 135 mph

weight.note: with power steering, ABS and airbag, from Honda’s 1997 launch table; evo gives 1,040 kg

variants.what: A hand-ported B16B, a seam-welded body, a helical limited-slip differential, Recaro seats and a titanium gear knob. Honda says the body was 35% stiffer than a normal Civic’s. A facelift came in September 1998, and about 16,000 EK9s were built in all.

variants.name: Civic Type R x
variants.what: The last EK9, from December 1999, with more comfort kit: a CD player, power windows, auto air conditioning, keyless entry, aluminum pedals and a carbon-look center panel.

B16B.name: Honda B16B
facts: Inline-4, DOHC with VTEC, belt-driven cams; VTEC switches over at 6,100 rpm
185 PS (182 hp) at 8,200 rpm, 160 Nm (118 lb-ft) at 7,500 rpm
About 114 bhp per liter, with no turbo
Hand-ported; uses the taller Integra Type R block, in effect a short-stroke B18C Type R engine

issues.rx: oil consumption|burn(s|ing)? oil|using oil|blue smoke|smok(e|ing) from (the )?(tail|exhaust)
issues.x: evo says some EK9s had a hunger for oil that not all owners kept up with, and to treat puffs of blue smoke as a sign the engine needs serious care. JDM Buy Sell suggests a compression or leak-down test.
The B16B has belt-driven cams. JDM Buy Sell’s buyer’s guide says to ask for dated proof of the last belt change and have a mechanic inspect the car.
JDM Buy Sell says to confirm the chassis code reads EK9, the engine is a real B16B and the car still has its helical limited-slip differential.
